sentence_shift: The plants in the Gardens now flower about 5 days earlier per decade than in 1997, roughly two weeks over the whole period.
sentence_warming: Canberra has warmed by about a third of a degree each decade since 1997, and in warmer years plants flowered 3.4–7.4 days earlier for each degree of extra warmth.
sentence_share: On these figures, warming accounts for roughly a fifth to a third of the change (18–36%). Rainfall made no clear difference.
sentence_families: Plant families are not shifting in their own distinctive ways: family explains only 6% of the differences between species. Most families are moving earlier along with the garden as a whole, and the wattles are the main exception.
